def solution():
    # Define variables
    fund_value = 100_000_000
    current_share_weight = 0.80
    target_share_weight = 0.60
    share_beta = 1.20
    futures_index_level = 1_200
    futures_multiplier = 250
    futures_beta = 0.95

    # Calculate the equity exposure to be shifted
    equity_exposure_shift = (
        (current_share_weight - target_share_weight)
        * fund_value
        * share_beta
    )

    # Calculate the beta-adjusted value of one stock index futures contract
    futures_contract_value = futures_index_level * futures_multiplier
    beta_adjusted_contract_value = futures_contract_value * futures_beta

    # Calculate the number of stock index futures contracts
    contracts = equity_exposure_shift / beta_adjusted_contract_value

    # Return the answer rounded to three decimal places
    return round(contracts, 3)
